inherited_methods.method: Exact CRT density over the full period M_k=product_{k<p<2k} p
inherited_methods.loss_step: Replace the ordered prefix (2k,H] by a uniformly random residue modulo M_k.
inherited_methods.lost_information: The location of the first allowed residue and the possibility of a long initial covered interval.
inherited_methods.consequence: Predicts scale exp((log 4+o(1))k/log k) but proves neither an upper nor a lower bound for n_k.

inherited_methods.method: Bonferroni or fundamental-lemma sieve on the interval [1,H]
inherited_methods.loss_step: Truncate inclusion-exclusion to products of primes not exceeding the distribution level H.
inherited_methods.lost_information: Almost all interaction orders among about k/log k dense half-residue constraints.
inherited_methods.consequence: At H=exp(Ck/log k), only O(k/log^2 k) constraints fit in a modulus, a vanishing fraction of the constraints that create the exponentially small density.

inherited_methods.method: Second moment over translations of a length-H window modulo M_k
inherited_methods.loss_step: Average the starting point of the window before asking about the fixed initial window beginning at 2k.
inherited_methods.lost_information: Exceptional translates, including precisely the translate defining n_k.
inherited_methods.consequence: Can show that typical windows contain allowed residues while leaving the first representative uncontrolled.

inherited_methods.loss_step: Treat the rational intervals ((n-k)/j,(n-1)/j) independently and use only a uniform prime-gap theorem.
inherited_methods.lost_information: Correlations among the many denominators j and Diophantine approximation of n/j.
inherited_methods.consequence: Gives polynomial or subexponential lower bounds but does not approach the conjectured exp(Theta(k/log k)) scale without a Konyagin-type amplification.

required_new_information: A deterministic certificate that transfers full-period CRT density to the specific initial prefix without assuming translation genericity.
A high-order correlation or pseudorandomness statement that sees a positive fraction of the k/log k congruence constraints while using moduli below exp(O(k/log k)).
For lower bounds, a quantitatively stronger simultaneous rational-approximation obstruction than the June 2026 Konyagin-type argument.
An exact finite adversary map separating valid density evidence from invalid least-representative inference.
